source.content:
The monks of Azeroth walk the path of the Pandaren, a martial tradition that arrived with the opening of Pandaria and spread quickly to students across both the Horde and the Alliance. Monks blend physical discipline with the manipulation of chi, a spiritual life force that flows through all living things, to achieve extraordinary feats of combat, healing, and focus.

Brewmasters fight with an improbable combination of acrobatics and alcoholic combustion; mistweavers channel chi into restorative mists that mend wounds at a distance; windwalkers strike with devastating speed, turning the flow of a fight with a single perfectly placed blow.
